verdict.rationale: Databricks ships AI features (Genie Code, AI Playground, AI Gateway), so whether customer data is kept out of model training is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses training-data use: there is no no-training policy, opt-out setting, or data-usage commitment for its AI services. The governance, AI Gateway and SOC 2 items cover access control and compliance, not training use, so they do not support this story.
